hook: What if your health journal could answer back?
caption: No typing, no scrolling. Speak through the small red pulse button, and your journal looks up the answer in your own records. Calm, source-aware, wellness info only, not medical advice. Ask your records. #HealthGraph #VoiceCheckIn #HealthJournal #AskYourRecords #DigitalHealth #HealthData #VoiceUI #WellnessInfo

lines.text: What if your health journal could answer back?
lines.beat: the red voice FAB pulses at the bottom of the explore-grid screen; a soft waveform ripple grows from it

lines.text: No typing. No scrolling through files.
lines.beat: ghost typing bubbles and a scrolling document list dissolve off-screen

lines.text: You just speak, through the small red pulse button.
lines.beat: close-up on the red voice FAB on its white pill; a thumb taps it, the mic waveform takes over

lines.text: You ask: how did I sleep this week?
lines.beat: the voice check-in waveform plays; the suggestion 'How did I sleep this week?' types on softly

lines.text: Your journal listens, then looks it up.
lines.beat: the waveform morphs into a thin search line sweeping across records

lines.text: It turns to your own records.
lines.beat: ai-chat screen opens; 'How may I Assist you today' header with the user's own records implied behind

lines.text: The answer comes back as calm, simple text.
lines.beat: an answer bubble types out slowly, referencing the daily-log entries (sleep 7h) as it forms

lines.text: Always from your history, not a chatbot guessing.
lines.beat: small source chips point back to the daily-log screen and to health-graph nodes

lines.text: Wellness info only, not medical advice.
lines.beat: the label 'Wellness info only. Not medical advice.' stamps under the answer in small type

lines.text: The journal remembers what you logged.
lines.beat: camera rests on the ai-chat with the red voice FAB still pulsing quietly
end card on warm charcoal with the red pulse button glowing beside the CTA
